name: Drumming Palm
description: Throw a pulse of blood-charged qi through the heel of the palm into the target's chest.

name: Vein Guard
description: Drive blood to the forearms so they thicken and take a blow without the bone giving way.

name: Quick Throb
description: Spend one hard heartbeat on a sudden sidestep that carries the body off the line of attack.

name: Warm Mend
description: Send warmed blood to a cut so the lips of the wound draw shut on an ally or the self.

name: Wristpulse
description: Hold a wrist and feel the pulse to learn how hurt or how frightened the body is.

name: Crimson Jab
description: Narrow the pulse into two fingers and stab the point of the blow through a soft guard.

name: Surging Fist
description: Pump the blood into the striking arm so the punch lands with the weight of a full surge.

name: Clot Shield
description: Thicken the blood at the point of impact so a strike is absorbed by a dense knot of flesh.

name: Redflow Step
description: Let the blood run into the legs and shift the weight in one smooth gliding step.

name: Rouse
description: Press a palm to an ally's back and wake the blood so tired limbs take on fresh strength.

name: Scarlet Lash
description: Flick a thin lash of blood-colored qi from the fingertips to sting a target at arm's reach and beyond.

name: Pulse Parry
description: Time a hard heartbeat to a sweeping forearm so an incoming blow slides aside.

name: Stanch
description: Press two fingers above a bleeding wound and compress the vessel until the flow stops for an ally or the self.

name: Heartstrike
description: Time a blow to the beat of the heart so the full pulse of the body rides behind the fist.

name: Plasma Drip
description: Flick a bead of pressed blood-qi from the knuckle that stings the face at short range.

name: Clotting Veil
description: Hold the breath and thicken a film of blood under the skin that blunts steady pressure.

name: Drumbeat Step
description: Stamp on the beat and glide forward a half pace before the opponent's guard resets.

name: Quiet Count
description: Count the heartbeats of a nearby body to learn whether it is calm and ready to move.

name: Throbbing Elbow
description: Load the elbow with a hard pulse and drive it short into the ribs at close range.

name: Red Spray
description: Fling a fine spray of blood-charged qi from the open hand to sting the eyes of a nearby target.

name: Vein Snap
description: Flick a finger at the target's wrist to spasm the vessel so the grip on a weapon slackens.

name: Flushing Step
description: Flush the legs with blood and pivot away from a lunge in one quick turn.

name: Sanguine Cord
description: Reach through the pulse of a held wrist and tie a cord of qi that slows the arm.

name: Quickening Blood
description: Hum the pulse of an ally's chest into a faster beat so their reactions sharpen for a few breaths.

name: Seeping Knit
description: Coax blood to seep into a deep scrape and knit its edges slowly on an ally or the self.

name: Arterial Brace
description: Swell the neck arteries and clench so a blow to the throat is caught by the thickened flesh.

name: Steady Beat
description: Slow the pulse to a calm even rhythm so the user and a near ally hold their aim under strain.

name: Rooted Heart
description: Sink the weight and the pulse together so a shove cannot move the body from its stance.

name: Pounding Fist
description: Hammer straight forward on each beat of the heart with the whole arm loaded by the pulse.

name: Missed Beat
description: Strike the chest on the gap between beats so the opponent's own pulse stumbles and their breath catches.

name: Restoring Flush
description: Warm a fatigued limb with steady blood until the numbness fades and the ally or the self moves freely.

name: Sinking Beat
description: Drop the weight with the exhale of the heart and slide low under a swinging arm.

name: Knitting Touch
description: Lay fingertips along a torn edge and let warm blood draw the flesh together on an ally or the self.

name: Warm Transfusion
description: Pass a measured share of the user's own vigor through a clasped hand to restore a weary ally.

name: Red Cleave
description: Chop down with an edge-hand heavy with surging blood to split a guard.

name: Lifeblood Guard
description: Gather blood at the chest and ribs so the frame holds against a heavy blow.

name: Pulse Dodge
description: Read the opponent's pulse tell and lean aside a breath before the blow comes.

name: Gentle Rousing
description: Squeeze an ally's shoulder to wake slack blood and ease the heaviness of a long march.

name: Pressure Ease
description: Release a bruised swelling by drawing pooled blood away from it for an ally or the self.

name: Hot Blood
description: Heat the blood of the user for a short burst of speed and strength in the limbs.

name: Surge Cross
description: Cross the body with a hot-blooded punch that hits harder than the arm alone could throw.

name: Clot Brace
description: Pack blood tight in the forearm and shin so a low kick breaks against a hardened guard.

name: Spitting Droplets
description: Snap several pea-sized beads of pressed blood-qi from a flicked wrist at a target's face.

name: Veinwalk
description: Burn a heated pulse in the calves to spring clear of a counter and land balanced.

name: Pulse Fetter
description: Hold the target's wrist and send a binding pulse that numbs the arm to the elbow.

name: Tether Vein
description: Fasten a thread of qi to a vein in the target's leg and drag its stride short.

name: Throb Break
description: Cut across the target's rhythm with a sharp pulse so a half-formed technique falters.

name: Heartlisten
description: Still the breath and hear the heartbeats of living bodies within a few paces.

name: Tight Grip
description: Clamp the target's arm with blood-hardened fingers and wrench it across the body.

name: Bracing Rush
description: Meet a shove with a surge down the arm and turn the pushing force past the body.
